---
title: "Components"
description: >
  What every kitDesign component looks like, and the R code that makes it.
---

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>")
library(shiny)
library(kitDesign)
# Value objects (status box, checklist, code) are also drawn as HTML in this document
for (cls in c("kit_status", "kit_check", "kit_checklist", "kit_code")) {
  registerS3method("knit_print", cls, function(x, ...) knitr::knit_print(htmltools::as.tags(x), ...),
                   envir = asNamespace("knitr"))
}
```

```{r kit-css, echo = FALSE}
# This page loads kitDesign's own styles: the components below are really rendered, not screenshots
htmltools::tagList(use_kit())
```

Every component on this page is rendered directly by kitDesign: each section shows the R code first, and right below it what it looks like.
The specs (when to use it, what not to do) are in the [design language](design-language.html); to see every component on your own computer:
`kitDesign::kit_gallery()`.

Things that only respond inside Shiny, like buttons and collapsibles, are shown here for their look only. Stateful components (modules) come last, as screenshots.

## Header

One per app, at the very top: logo, tool name, subtitle, version line. `kit_page()` already includes it.

::: {.kit-live}
```{r}
kit_header(
  "KIT 資料串接工具", "臺灣幼兒發展調查資料庫", tagline = "跨波次資料處理",   # "KIT Data Join Tool", "Kids in Taiwan", "Cross-wave data processing"
  version = "0.5.0", date = "2026-10-31",
  logo = "inline"   # in Shiny use the default TRUE; this is a static web page, so the logo is written into the page
)
```
:::

## Step tabs (NavTabs)

A grouped, unnumbered tab bar (as in kitJoin). The current tab is lime; the dashed box is the "tools" group.

::: {.kit-live}
```{r}
kit_navgroups(list(
  kit_navgroup("準備", c(upload = "檔案上傳", missing = "遺漏值處理")),        # "Prepare": "Upload files", "Missing values"
  kit_navgroup("做出資料", c(join = "串接", kits = "轉成 kits 作答檔")),      # "Build data": "Join", "Convert to kits response file"
  kit_navgroup("其他工具", c(manual = "使用手冊"), tools = TRUE)               # "Other tools": "User manual"
), tabset = "tabs", selected = "join")
```
:::

## Page guide: what this page does (PageGuide)

One sentence at the top of each page, with "看步驟 ▸" ("See steps ▸") next to it; the steps and what you get are collapsed by default.

::: {.kit-live}
```{r}
kit_tab_guide(
  goal = "把兩個波次的檔案依 ID 接成一張寬資料。",   # "Join files from two waves by ID into one wide table."
  steps = c("選 ID 欄", "選要保留哪些人", "按「執行串接」", "看狀態框與結果"),
  # "Pick the ID column", "Choose who to keep", "Click 'Run join'", "Check the status box and results"
  output = "一張寬資料：一人一列。"                   # "One wide table: one row per person."
)
```
:::

## Button

Only one primary button per page (lime). Secondary buttons are for downloads and select-all; the danger button is salmon. A disabled button is gray,
and always has "還差：…" ("Still needed: …") above it.

::: {.kit-live}
```{r}
tags$div(
  style = "display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 0.6rem 1rem;",
  kit_button("run", "開始校準", "primary"),           # "Start calibration"
  kit_button("csv", "下載 CSV"),                      # "Download CSV"
  kit_button("skip", "這一回合不做", "danger"),        # "Skip this run"
  kit_button("convert", "執行轉換", "primary", disabled = TRUE)   # "Run conversion"
)
```
:::

## Download button (DownloadButton)

Looks the same as a secondary button; Chinese file names save correctly in every browser (the last part of the URL, the file name header, and the `download`
attribute all use the same name). Put it inside `renderUI()` in the server; the file is written only when the user clicks download. Here it is drawn with a
test session, so clicking it does nothing.

::: {.kit-live}
```{r}
session <- shiny::MockShinySession$new()
tags$div(
  class = "kit-downloads",
  kit_download_button(session, "dl_csv", "下載 CSV", "第一波 資料.csv",   # "Download CSV", "Wave 1 data.csv"
                      function(file) utils::write.csv(mtcars, file),
                      class = kit_btn_class("secondary")),
  kit_download_button(session, "dl_gz", "下載作答檔（.csv.gz）", "kits_long.csv.gz",   # "Download response file (.csv.gz)"
                      function(file) writeLines("x", file), class = "btn-primary")
)
```
:::

## Status box (StatusBox)

The first thing to look at after clicking the primary button. There are only four kinds: 【完成】 (Done), 【完成，但請注意】 (Done, but take note), 【停下來】 (Stopped), 【要重新執行】 (Needs a rerun).
The first line is a one-sentence conclusion, followed by at most 3 points; anything more is collapsed.

::: {.kit-live}
```{r}
kit_done_status("串接完成：結果共 3,389 列 × 2,058 欄。",   # "Join done: 3,389 rows × 2,058 columns."
                points = c("688 人每個檔案都有資料。", "第 1 波 3,389 人，第 2 波 3,102 人。"))
                # "688 people have data in every file.", "Wave 1: 3,389 people; wave 2: 3,102 people."
```
:::

::: {.kit-live}
```{r}
kit_done_status(
  "串接完成：結果共 3,389 列 × 2,058 欄。",
  warnings = c("有 12 人的 ID 重複，只留第一筆。", "第 3 波沒有 sex 欄。")
  # "12 people have duplicate IDs; only the first record is kept.", "Wave 3 has no sex column."
)
```
:::

::: {.kit-live}
```{r}
kit_error_status(simpleError("object 'subj_id' not found"), "串接")   # "Join"
```
:::

::: {.kit-live}
```{r}
kit_stale_status("執行串接")   # "Run join"
```
:::

## Callout

Info is sky blue; take-note is yellow. A callout is not a result, so it has no shadow.

::: {.kit-live}
```{r}
kit_callout("外部連結不適用：這一回合只有一個世代，這不是錯誤。")
# "External linking does not apply: this run has only one cohort. This is not an error."
kit_callout("資料裡有疑似遺漏值代碼，建議先到「遺漏值處理」。", warn = TRUE)
# "The data contain what look like missing-value codes. Go to 'Missing values' first."
```
:::

Cloud version (`kit_is_cloud()`): a yellow banner line under the header, and the usage notes in small gray text at the very bottom of the page.
The text belongs to the app: each section's title and body, and the reference links.

::: {.kit-live}
```{r}
kit_cloud_banner("此為雲端版：上傳的資料會傳送至位於美國的 Posit 伺服器。",
                 tags$a(href = "#kit-cloud-terms", "〈雲端版使用須知〉"), "。")
# "This is the cloud version: uploaded data are sent to Posit servers in the US." "(Cloud version usage notes)"
kit_cloud_footer(
  sections = list(
    "一、資料傳輸與儲存" = c("本雲端版部署於 Posit Connect Cloud，主機位於美國。",
                             "本工具不另行保存、備份或分享您的資料。"),
    # "1. Data transfer and storage": "This cloud version runs on Posit Connect Cloud, hosted in the US.",
    #   "This tool does not separately keep, back up, or share your data."
    "二、免責聲明" = "本工具以現況提供，僅供資料處理輔助之用。"
    # "2. Disclaimer": "This tool is provided as is, only to assist with data processing."
  ),
  links = c("Posit Trust Center" = "https://trust.posit.co",
            "Posit 隱私權政策" = "https://posit.co/about/privacy-policy/")   # "Posit privacy policy"
)
```
:::

## Data table (DataTable)

The table is as wide as its content; when it is too wide, it scrolls sideways inside its own frame. A line of small text above it gives the number of rows and columns.

::: {.kit-live}
```{r}
waves <- data.frame(
  id = 101:105, cohort = c("M03", "M36", "M03", "M36", "M03"), wave_m = c(3, 6, 12, 3, 6),
  income = c(32000, 45500, 28750, 51200, 39900)
)
tagList(
  tags$p(class = "kit-hint", kit_rows_note(120, ncol(waves), shown_rows = 5)),
  kit_table_scroll(kit_static_table(waves))
)
```
:::

## Chart

Pass a plotly chart to `kit_plotly_style()` as the last step: font, axis lines, legend, and toolbar match the app.
For before/after comparisons and usage, see ["Charts"](charts.html). Categorical colors use the colorblind-friendly Okabe–Ito palette:

::: {.kit-live}
```{r}
swatch <- function(col, name) {
  tags$div(
    tags$div(style = paste0("width: 4rem; height: 2rem; border: 2px solid var(--nb-ink); ",
                            "border-radius: 8px; background: ", col)),
    tags$small(class = "kit-hint", name)
  )
}
cols <- kit_chart_colors()
tags$div(style = "display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.6rem;",
         Map(swatch, cols, names(cols)), swatch(kit_chart_neutral(), "neutral"))
```
:::

## Details row (Details)

A row of collapsed details under the result: log, check table, How to do it in R. Open them when you need them.

::: {.kit-live}
```{r}
kit_details_row(
  kit_detail("這一回合的紀錄", tags$p("2026-10-31 14:02 串接 2 個檔案。")),   # "Log for this run": "... joined 2 files."
  kit_detail("用 R 怎麼做", kit_code("joined <- dplyr::left_join(t1, t2, by = \"subj_id\")"))   # "How to do it in R"
)
```
:::

Advanced settings (collapsed by default) and the settings summary:

::: {.kit-live}
```{r}
tagList(
  kit_advanced(checkboxInput("trim", "比對前去掉 ID 前後的空白", TRUE)),   # "Trim spaces around IDs before matching"
  kit_settings_line(c("2 個檔案", "ID：subj_id", "向後追蹤樣本"))        # "2 files", "ID: subj_id", "Follow-up sample"
)
```
:::

## How to do it in R (CodePanel)

Code for one version: at most 70 characters per line (longer lines wrap automatically), with "複製" ("Copy") next to it.

::: {.kit-live}
```{r}
kit_code(
  "scores <- kits::kits_subj(X, item, persons = persons, method = \"WLE\", se = TRUE, theta_range = c(-6, 6))",
  "kits 版"   # "kits version"
)
```
:::

## Step card (StepCard)

One step at a time: the current step has a border and shadow, done steps collapse to a one-line summary ("改" ("Edit") goes back), and steps that can't be done yet are gray.

::: {.kit-live}
```{r}
tagList(
  kit_step_card(kit_step_head(1, "每個檔案是哪個世代、哪個波次", "done",   # "Which cohort and wave each file is"
                              summary = "2 個檔案 · 世代 TDCYP", edit_id = "edit1")),   # "2 files · cohort TDCYP"
  kit_step_card(
    kit_step_head(2, "哪些欄是題目", "current", title_id = "st2"),   # "Which columns are items"
    kit_step_body(tags$p("挑出哪些欄是題目（至少一題）。"), actionButton("ok2", "對，下一步")),
    # "Pick the columns that are items (at least one)." "Yes, next"
    title_id = "st2"
  ),
  kit_step_card(kit_step_head(3, "計分檢查", "locked"))   # "Scoring check"
)
```
:::

## Checklist

Things to review before converting: ! needs a decision (with buttons next to it), ✓ fine, i a reminder.

::: {.kit-live}
```{r}
kit_checklist(
  kit_check("todo", "有 3 題的分數從 1 開始", "kits 要的分數是 0、1、2…。可以全部減 1，或照原樣。",
            actions = list(kit_button("shift", "全部減 1（建議）"), kit_button("keep", "照原樣"))),
  # "3 items have scores starting at 1", "kits needs scores 0, 1, 2…. You can subtract 1 from all, or keep them as is."
  # buttons: "Subtract 1 from all (recommended)", "Keep as is"
  kit_check("ok", "45 題的分數都是整數"),                   # "All 45 items have integer scores"
  kit_check("note", "有 2 題沒有人作答，不會放進作答檔")      # "2 items have no responses and won't go into the response file"
)
```
:::

## Ready line: what's still needed (ReadyLine)

When the primary button can't be clicked yet, a line above it says what is still needed, with a link next to it that takes the user where to fix it.

::: {.kit-live}
```{r}
tagList(
  kit_ready_line("至少要 2 個波次的檔案，目前只有 1 個",   # "Needs files from at least 2 waves; there is only 1 now"
                 actionLink("goto_upload", "到「檔案上傳」加入檔案 →")),   # "Go to 'Upload files' to add files →"
  kit_button("join", "執行串接", "primary", disabled = TRUE)   # "Run join"
)
```
:::

## Next step (NextStep)

When a page is done, the bottom of the page tells the user where to go next.

::: {.kit-live}
```{r}
kit_next_step("串接好了。接著把資料轉成 kits 作答檔。", "next", "下一步：轉成作答檔")
# "Join done. Next, convert the data into a kits response file." "Next: convert to response file"
```
:::

## Diagram

Small table before processing → small table after processing. New columns are light lime, with "（新）" ("(new)") after the column name.

::: {.kit-live}
```{r}
kit_diagram(
  list(kit_dg_table(data.frame(id = 1:2, score = c(3, 5)), "第 1 波（t1）"),      # "Wave 1 (t1)"
       kit_dg_table(data.frame(id = c(1, 3), score = c(4, 6)), "第 2 波（t2）")),  # "Wave 2 (t2)"
  kit_dg_table(data.frame(id = 1:2, score_t1 = c(3, 5), score_t2 = c(4, NA), wave = c(2, 1)),
               "結果", added = "wave"),   # "Result"
  "依 id 接起來：第 2 波沒有出席的人，t2 的格子是空的。"
  # "Joined by id: for people absent in wave 2, the t2 cells are empty."
)
```
:::

## Run tab (RunTab)

Tabs with one primary button each (kitJoin's join, stack, attrition sample, missing values, long/wide reshaping, and format conversion) all share one skeleton:
`kit_run_tab_ui()` lays out the fixed parts following the page skeleton, with the tab's own settings in the middle; `kit_run_tab_server()`,
called inside the tab's `moduleServer()`, handles still needed, the settings summary, running, the status box, notifications, scrolling to the status box,
【要重新執行】 (Needs a rerun), and the result details and "How to do it in R". Below is how it looks before there is a server (settings summary, status box,
and result are empty, and the primary button is disabled).

::: {.kit-live}
```{r}
kit_run_tab_ui(
  "stack", "執行疊加",   # "Run stack"
  guide = kit_tab_guide("把各波資料上下疊起來：每個人在每一波各佔一列。", c("按「執行疊加」", "看狀態框與預覽"), "一張長格式的資料。"),
  # "Stack each wave's data on top of each other: one row per person per wave.",
  # "Click 'Run stack'", "Check the status box and preview", "One long-format table."
  selectInput("stack-wave_col", "波次欄的名稱", c("wave", "t"))   # "Name of the wave column"
)
```
:::

Server (inside the tab's `moduleServer()`):

```r
tab <- kit_run_tab_server(
  input, output, session, "執行疊加",
  ready = reactive(kit_need_files(length(files()), 2L)),       # Still needed: … (disables the primary button)
  settings = function() paste0(length(files()), " 個檔案"),     # This run: … ("N files")
  stale_on = function() list(files(), input$wave_col),         # changed → 【要重新執行】 (Needs a rerun)
  progress = "正在疊加資料…",                                   # "Stacking data…"
  run = function() dplyr::bind_rows(files(), .id = input$wave_col),
  done = function(res) kit_done_status(paste0("疊加完成：結果共 ", kit_dims(nrow(res), ncol(res)), "。")),
  details_ui = function(res) kit_detail("結果預覽", kit_preview_table(res)),   # "Result preview"
  code = function() "stacked <- dplyr::bind_rows(t1, t2, .id = \"wave\")"
)
list(state = tab$state)                                        # used by step tabs for the ✓
```

## Modules (stateful components)

The four components below only work inside Shiny (which step is open, whether a button can be clicked, the ✓ on tabs),
so they are shown as screenshots. Each takes one line in each place: `*_ui(id)` goes in the page, `*_server(id)` goes in the server.

**Step cards**: `kit_stepcards_ui()` / `kit_stepcards_server()`

<img class="kit-shot" src="figures/module-stepcards.jpg" alt="Step cards: step 1 done (check mark, one-line summary, edit), step 2 open, step 3 not available yet" width="900">

**Primary button + still needed**: `kit_run_gate_ui()` / `kit_run_gate_server()`

<img class="kit-shot" src="figures/module-rungate.jpg" alt="Settings summary, the primary button 執行串接 (Run join), and below it a 【完成，但請注意】 (Done, but take note) status box" width="900">

**Step tabs**: `kit_step_tabs_ui()` / `kit_step_tabs_server()` (flow tabs: ✓ when done, gray when not available yet)

<img class="kit-shot" src="figures/module-steptabs.jpg" alt="A grouped tab bar and an ordered flow tab bar; ① and ② are checked, ④ is not available yet" width="900">

**How to do it in R**: `kit_code_panel_ui()` / `kit_code_panel_server()` (code is computed only when opened)

<img class="kit-shot" src="figures/module-codepanel.jpg" alt="The opened How to do it in R panel: code wraps automatically, with a copy button next to it" width="900">
